name: oidc-id-jag
summary: Cross-App Access — Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant (ID-JAG)
description: Implements the Identity Provider Authorization Server role of draft-ietf-oauth-identity-assertion-authz-grant (Cross-App Access): a confidential client exchanges one of its tokens against a short lived `oauth-id-jag+jwt` assertion targeting another authorization server, which it then presents using the JWT Bearer grant. The plugin answers RFC 8693 token exchange requests asking for `urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id-jag` through the `oidcGotTokenExchange` hook, so the token endpoint is left untouched. It resolves the requested audience into the relying party declaring it, enforces that RP's `TokenXAuthorizedRP` list and access rule, and signs the assertion with an asymmetric key so the remote server can verify it against the published JWKS. `subject_token` accepts an ID token, a refresh token or an access token.
author: Xavier Guimard <yadd@debian.org>
